opaqueRoundTripFix.rootCause: Writing Chat reasoning_opaque to Responses encrypted_content, then rejecting that reasoning item on the next materialized request, self-locks tool-result return or later user turns.
behavior: Only nonempty readable reasoning_text/reasoning_content creates a reasoning summary item.
reasoning_opaque is ignored, never emitted as encrypted_content, and never creates an empty card or splits a text segment.
Input reasoning and web_search_call metadata are skipped, including legacy encrypted reasoning; materialized messages, function calls and tool results are preserved.
previous_response_id, compaction, item_reference and unextracted input_file still fail before upstream transmission.

nativeToolRoundTrips.error: unsupported_input for the bridge's own encrypted reasoning history

assertions: First turn completes after exactly two upstream requests, including the real core's tool result return.
Next user turn in the same native thread also completes, producing a third upstream request.
No upstream request contains the synthetic opaque token.
No bridge fixture errors are recorded.

limitations: Synthetic upstream with the real installed Codex app-server, not paid real-account gemini-fixture-pro inference.
No active Desktop/Gateway restart, runtime synchronization or formal release.
The separate personality interpolation finding in 2026-11-13-display-standard-rereview.json is not resolved by this P0-only change.
